description:
A web hosting company has three client domains on a shared server. Each domain has been assigned to a different hosting plan tier, and the sysadmin needs to apply the correct disk quota and monthly bandwidth limits.

Using the Virtualmin control panel (accessible at https://localhost:10000, login: root / GymAnything123!), configure the following resource limits for each virtual server domain:

1. acmecorp.test (Premium Plan):
   - Disk quota: 2048 MB
   - Monthly bandwidth limit: 10 GB

2. greenleaf.test (Standard Plan):
   - Disk quota: 1024 MB
   - Monthly bandwidth limit: 5 GB

3. craftworks.test (Basic Plan):
   - Disk quota: 512 MB
   - Monthly bandwidth limit: 2 GB

For each domain, navigate to its configuration (Edit Virtual Server / Quotas and Limits), set the disk quota and bandwidth limit to the specified values, and save the changes.

All three domains currently have unlimited quotas and bandwidth. After completing the task, each domain should show its respective limits in the Virtualmin domain configuration.
